# intrinsics.library: EmptyList

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A fresh empty List whose element type matches the given array. Lets a
> generic body obtain a builder where the element type is a type variable,
> without naming a concrete type in `new List<...>()`.

## Signature

